name: The Nightclub
body: Near Morrighan and Vesper's room, because Vesper DJs and Morrighan does not believe in commuting. Professional sound system, programmable lighting rig, a bar Vesper stocks with the precision of a woman who has mixed drinks at 3 AM for twenty-eight girls and not once lost count. Dance floor with room for a dozen and enough shadow at the edges for couples who prefer to watch. Pepper has been banned from the DJ booth twice. She has accessed it three times.
